Usage: sink action [OPTIONS] SERVER [ACTION_NAME]

  Run a pre defined command on the server.

  If a section named 'actions' is in sink.yaml, run the requested action or
  list the available actions for that server.

  For example, add the following to one of the servers.  It will list all
  files ending in .cache on the requested server.

  actions:
    find-cache: find . -iname cache

  Instead of using one of the servers, you can use the special name 'local'
  for a server.  This will use the commands in the project section.

  If no action is specified, all actions available to that server will be
  listed.

Options:
  -r, --real
  --show-commands  Show action commands; they may contain secrets.
  -h, --help       Show this message and exit.
